svg.aria-label: The last byte p of the plaintext is checked by the length test and the byte test. If both pass, strip removes the tag and p plus one padding bytes; otherwise strip zero removes only the last t bytes as the tag.
svg.text: Example: a decrypted plaintext P of ℓP​ = 64 bytes (four 16-byte blocks), tag length t = 20

text.font-family: STIX Two Math, Latin Modern Math, Cambria Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: Πstrict​(P) holds iff both checks pass:

text.font-family: STIX Two Math, Latin Modern Math, Cambria Math, Times New Roman, serif

svg.text: the last p + 1 bytes of P all equal p
